title: Sensor firmware versions MT 1.6 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new beta sensor firmware is now available on Wed, 31 Jan 2024

New feature: Update MT15 to use Public Building Air Quality (PBAQ) algorithm for TVOC
Bug fixes: General bug fixes and performance improvement [mt10, mt12, mt15, mt20, mt30 and mt40]
